explication: NewPipe Extractor is a Java library that turns streaming-site URLs and queries into structured metadata and media information. A typical client selects a site service, resolves a URL or search query into a handler, obtains the corresponding extractor, and consumes extracted results; pagination and other listing features extend that workflow. The tree and README document several content types and five site adapters. Source excerpts are limited, so edges between unsampled components are omitted rather than inferred; documented service capabilities are retained as distinct branches.
